revision_note: 2026-10-14 (DECISION-012): a director keeps a household on the program after reviewing a submitted field report that recommends retention or verifies SWDI Level 1 or 2. The household returns UNDER_INVESTIGATION -> ACTIVE_COMPLIANT, the task becomes VERIFIED_RETAIN with admin_resolution RETAINED_ON_ROSTER, and one BENEFICIARY_RETAINED block is sealed (the single approved addition to the frozen audit action list). The model may not re-flag the household until `reassessment_allowed_from` (180-day cooldown). A calamity moratorium does not block retention.
